summary: Iteration 47 — validated the new legal WORKING-DRAFT workflow (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter47_working_drafts.py (17 pytest cases, all passing): counsel upload -> working draft only (released .md byte-identical before/after), working-drafts list/detail (is_stale=false, change_log, no _id, content_md omitted in list), .docx working-draft download (correct content-type + Content-Disposition '03-cookie-notice.working-draft.docx', PK zip magic), mark-ready -> awaiting_admin, counsel release -> 403 'Only admin can release', admin release -> 200 {released_as_version, ratification_id, rebuilt_docx:true, state:'released'} + ratification row created + .md promoted, 2 MB cap -> 400, unknown slug -> 404, empty file -> 400, unsupported .pdf -> 400, anonymous upload -> 401/403, discard (counsel 403 / admin 200 / repeat 404), _bump_minor unit matrix (1.2->1.3, 2->2.1, ''->1.0, 1.2.9->1.2.10), version override '2.0' wins, auto-bump 2.0->2.1, apply-roundtrip now writes to the working draft and leaves the released .md untouched. Frontend: Counsel Console shortcut verified in BOTH dropdowns, /counsel renders 6 doc rows for counsel and admin, counsel correctly has NO release/discard buttons, admin upload->badge->Release modal (prefilled v1.0 + notes + confirm)->row updates to 'Released v1.0' and working-draft badge disappears, mark-ready and Discard verified end-to-end. All test data (working drafts, ratifications, roundtrips) removed and all legal_docs/*.md restored + bundle rebuilt.

critical.issue: Ratification body_hash is stale, so the public page still says it is an unratified first draft AFTER a successful release. Order of operations: fp.write_text(working_draft) -> body_hash = hash(working_draft) -> _run_docx_rebuild() which executes scripts/eu_compliance_and_docx.py and APPENDS the 'EU / UK Compliance Addendum' to the same .md. The hash stored on legal_doc_ratifications therefore no longer matches the file on disk. Reproduced: released v9.9 of 03-cookie-notice -> stored body_hash 593ed4f59a6b3ac9 vs actual 801ea575704718f6 (MATCH: False) and GET /api/legal/pages/cookie-notice returned ratified=false immediately after release. Fix: run the rebuild FIRST (or re-read the file after rebuild) and compute body_hash from the final on-disk content before inserting the ratification.

minor.issue: Because the rebuild script appends the compliance addendum, the released .md is a superset of the bytes counsel uploaded — it is not byte-identical to the working draft. Not wrong, but the docstring/UI copy ('overwrites the released .md') should say so, otherwise counsel will report duplicated addenda on round-trips.

payload is a bare required `dict`, so calling them with no body returns 422 instead of behaving like an empty payload. Frontend always sends a body so it is not user-visible, but a Pydantic model with defaults would be more forgiving.

ui_bugs.issue: The back link and the page label/heading render inline and visually collide — text reads 'Admin HubLEGAL · COUNSEL CONSOLE' with the h1 on the same row. The <Link> is inline-flex with mb-6 but the following `span.label` and `h1` are inline/inline-flex so they wrap onto the link's line. Wrap the back link in a block element (or add `block w-fit`).

When a working draft exists the row grows to 6 action buttons; at 1920px the action column wraps to two rows and squeezes the title column so the doc title breaks mid-phrase ('Cookie &' / 'Tracking Notice') and the badges stack vertically. Give the action column a wider lg:min-w or move Release/Discard to a second labelled group.

The file <input> value is never reset after a completed upload (no `e.target.value = ''` in onChange), so re-selecting the identical file may not fire change in some browsers and the user sees nothing happen.

rca_of_the_issue: release_working_draft() writes the working-draft markdown to <slug>.md, computes body_hash from that in-memory string, then calls _run_docx_rebuild() which shells out to scripts/eu_compliance_and_docx.py. That script appends the EU/UK Compliance Addendum to the .md, changing its body. The ratification row is inserted with the pre-append hash, so every downstream 'is this doc ratified?' comparison (public legal pages, first-draft banner) fails and the site keeps showing 'FIRST DRAFT — PENDING COUNSEL RATIFICATION' even though an admin just released and ratified the doc. Mitigation: rebuild first, then re-read the file from disk and hash the final content before inserting the ratification.
